src: ; 05 reduction_shuffle — warp-level sum with SHFL.DOWN, then one atomic per warp
;   for (int off = 4; off > 0; off >>= 1)          // warp size 8 here
; No shared memory, no barrier: registers move directly between lanes.
SHFL.DOWN R6, R5, 4          ; lane l gets v from lane l+4
ADD   R5, R5, R6             ; lane 0 now holds the warp's sum
ATOM.ADD R10, [R9], R5       ; out[0] += warp sum
